short: Compare the slopes of the Hermitian lattices

lean.name: Formalism.DivisorInequality.BoundsMu
lean.plain: Compare the slopes of the Hermitian lattices
lean.note: At the infinite places the determinant ratio for the composite lift factors into the ratios for its individual lifts and a scalar power. Together with the estimates at the finite places, this bounds the period-lattice slope above by an expression containing the normalised covolumes of the auxiliary lattices.
